title: Fiesta de Luz Holiday Boat Parade Returns to Lake Casa Blanca on Dec. 12
excerpt: The Fiesta de Luz holiday boat parade returns to Lake Casa Blanca State Park on Dec. 12 after stopping during the COVID-19 pandemic, with up to 20 boats expected and the lake now more than 18 feet deep at its deepest point, according to KGNS.
content:
The Fiesta de Luz holiday boat parade is returning to Lake Casa Blanca State Park on Dec. 12, after stopping during the COVID-19 pandemic, according to KGNS.

Park superintendent Querubín Guerra said visitors have been asking for the parade's return for a few years. A test run on July 4 drew four boats, and organizers expect up to 20 boats for the December parade, KGNS reported.

There is no fee to enter the parade, and there is no judging and no prizes, according to KGNS. Boaters arrive early to decorate their boats and pass a safety inspection. Park entry is $4 for visitors ages 13 and older.

Recent rain has raised the lake's water level: its deepest point was about 11 to 12 feet deep before the rain and is now a little over 18 feet, KGNS reported. All three concrete boat ramps are usable.

Boaters should stay alert for floating grass clumps, plastic bags and jugs washed in by rainwater through the creeks, which can clog a motor or catch a propeller, Guerra said.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 13, 2026.
